title: South Korea Unveils Crypto Bill Capping Exchange Ownership at 20%
summary: Bitcoin Magazine South Korea Unveils Crypto Bill Capping Exchange Ownership at 20% South Korea’s financial regulator unveiled a bill that would cap major shareholders of crypto exchanges at 20%, allow domestic ICOs and let bank-led groups issue won stablecoins. This post South Korea Unveils Crypto Bill Capping Exchange Ownership at 20% first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
